The image shows a dried, brown, and withered leaf, which is characteristic of tissue death starting from the tip and progressing downwards. This symptom is a classic presentation of Die_Back disease. Anthracnose typically presents as distinct, dark, sunken lesions. Powdery mildew would appear as white, powdery spots. Sooty mould would be a black, superficial fungal growth.
